data.one_liner: Automatic capture of exceptions and GraphQL errors for the gql ecosystem like graphql and ferry.
data.what_it_does: SentryLink integrates with the gql ecosystem (such as graphql and ferry) to automatically capture exceptions, GraphQL errors, and performance traces for requests. It helps improve exception reporting through custom extractors and provides serialization/parsing tracing for HttpLink and DioLink.
use_when: You are using the gql ecosystem (graphql, ferry, artemis) in your Dart or Flutter application
You want to automatically report GraphQL errors and exceptions to Sentry
You want performance monitoring and tracing for GraphQL requests and serialization
avoid_when: You are not using Sentry for error tracking or performance monitoring
You are not using the gql package ecosystem for network requests
strengths: Seamless integration with popular GraphQL packages like graphql, ferry, and artemis
Supports performance monitoring and tracing for serialization and parsing
Provides tools to filter redundant HTTP breadcrumbs
weaknesses: Tied strictly to Sentry and the gql package ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add SentryGql.link() to your GraphQL link chain and optionally configure exception extractors in Sentry.init.
